% cp_t4 — Replication of Cieslak–Povala (2015), Table 4: predicting individual
% returns with the cycle factor.
% Numbers transcribed from tables/cp_t4.pdf (generated by empirical.R).
\small
\begin{tabular}{l ccc}
  \toprule
  & $\rx^{(2)}$ & $\rx^{(5)}$ & $\rx^{(10)}$ \\
  \midrule
  \panel{4}{Panel A. Single cycle factor} \\[0.2em]
  $\CF_{t}$                  & $0.70$          & $1.47$          & $1.51$ \\
                             & $(2.02)$        & $(3.43)$        & $(4.32)$ \\
  $\bar{R}^{2}$              & $0.09$          & $0.23$          & $0.29$ \\
  $\Delta\bar{R}^{2}$        & $0.31$          & $0.24$          & $0.25$ \\
  \addlinespace
  \panel{4}{Panel B.1. Short and own-maturity cycle} \\[0.2em]
  $\cyc^{(1)}_{t}$           & $-0.66$         & $-0.66$         & $-0.40$ \\
                             & $(-1.70)$       & $(-3.24)$       & $(-4.07)$ \\
  $\cyc^{(n)}_{t}$           & $0.78$          & $1.10$          & $1.11$ \\
                             & $(1.91)$        & $(3.50)$        & $(4.95)$ \\
  $\bar{R}^{2}$              & $0.06$          & $0.22$          & $0.40$ \\
  \addlinespace
  \panel{4}{Panel B.2. Own-maturity cycle only} \\[0.2em]
  $\cyc^{(n)}_{t}$           & $0.06$          & $0.16$          & $0.42$ \\
                             & $(0.76)$        & $(1.08)$        & $(2.19)$ \\
  $\bar{R}^{2}$              & $0.02$          & $0.03$          & $0.14$ \\
  \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\tabnotes{The dependent variable is the duration-standardised individual
  one-year excess return $\rx^{(n)}_{t+12}/n$ for $n\in\{2,5,10\}$ years;
  United States, $264$ observations. Panel~A regresses the return on the
  single cycle factor $\CF_{t}$; $t$-statistics in parentheses
  are Newey--West adjusted ($18$ lags). $\Delta\bar{R}^{2}$ is the additional adjusted $R^{2}$
  obtained when the single factor is replaced by the unrestricted regression
  on the six yields and trend inflation. Panel~B.1 regresses the return on the
  one-year cycle $\cyc^{(1)}_{t}$ and the own-maturity cycle $\cyc^{(n)}_{t}$;
  Panel~B.2 uses $\cyc^{(n)}_{t}$ alone. The table replicates
  \citet{cieslak2015}, Table~4.}
